pages.text: Put a $(item)battery meter$() on a power wire. Its face shows the batteries on that wire as a 12 V bank: the $(thing)voltage$() and the $(thing)charge$(), with an arrow up while they charge and down while they discharge. Power passes through it from any side, like a wire junction.$(br2)At rest it reads 11.8 V empty to 12.7 V full. Charging lifts it towards 14.4 V; a heavy load sags it a little.

Use it for the full reading in chat: how many batteries, the charge, and how fast it is going in or out, with the time left to full or to empty.$(br2)A $(item)comparator$() beside it reads the charge: 0 empty, 15 full. Use it to switch a generator on when the bank runs low.
